name: retail-analytics-lakehouse
description: End-to-end analytics engineering on DuckDB + Parquet: multi-process synthetic e-commerce data, medallion lakehouse (bronze/silver/gold), mini-dbt SQL DAG, YAML data-quality tests, cohort/RFM/CLV/market-basket/ROAS marts, Plotly + Streamlit dashboards.

paragraphs: An end-to-end analytics-engineering platform for a fictional direct-to-consumer retailer, Aurora Goods Co. - from raw, messy source extracts to an executive dashboard - running as a laptop-scale lakehouse on DuckDB + Parquet. A reproducible, multi-process generator lands 900K rows of realistic e-commerce data (orders, web funnel events, marketing spend) with 1-2% injected data-quality defects; an idempotent ingestion layer turns it into Hive-partitioned Parquet; a home-grown mini-dbt DAG runner builds a silver layer (cleaning, de-duplication, quarantine) and a Kimball star schema with…

features: Every number below was produced by retail-lakehouse run-all on the default scale (25,000 customers, 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, seed 42) on the development laptop; they are re-written into this table by retail-lakehouse…
Parallel, deterministic generation - one process per calendar month with per-chunk seeds;
the landing zone is byte-identical for 1 or N workers (asserted in the test suite).
Idempotent bronze ingestion - sha256 manifest of every landed file; re-running is a
no-op, a modified landing file is rejected, --full-refresh rebuilds.
